selection: minimum mean parent-validation NLL, no final test data generated or evaluated in this mechanism pilot
evaluation: uniform fixed coordinates in complete true genealogies with census nodes and truth annotations removed
interpretation: Training/validation engineering study only. This does not establish final held-out or inferred-tree performance.
comparison_note: All neural families receive identical all-node observed-reference summaries. GraphSSM uses its documented native diffusion encoder. Other GNN families share the mean-MPNN definition. Feature MLP omits edges.
